name: check_api_status
title: Is this API / provider down right now?
description: Check whether one AI or developer API provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, Groq, GitHub, Stripe, Cloudflare, Vercel, Supabase, Twilio, ~40 total) is up, degraded, or down right now. Use before calling that provider, or right after 5xx/429/timeouts, to choose retry, wait, or a fallback. Not for a model id (check_model_deprecation), the filtered change feed (list_recent_api_changes), or the daily rollup (get_digest). Returns summary, verdict (up|degraded|partially down|down|unknown), recommended_action, incidents, affected_components, checked_at, and freshness; status is rechecked about every 5 minutes. An unknown provider id returns 404 unknown_provider. Example: {"provider":"openai"}. Free within the daily quota, then $0.003 via x402. Alias: get_status.

provider.description: Lowercase provider id from list_providers, not the display name. Examples: openai, anthropic, google-ai, mistral, groq, github, stripe, cloudflare.

name: check_model_deprecation
title: Is this model deprecated, and what replaces it?
description: Check whether one LLM model id is active, deprecated, or retired, plus its shutdown date and replacement, from that provider's deprecation page (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and other tracked LLM vendors). Use before hard-coding or calling a model, or when a call fails with model-not-found. Not for API uptime (check_api_status) and not for a retirement feed (list_recent_api_changes with kind model_retirement, or get_digest). Returns summary, verdict (active|deprecated|retired|unknown), recommended_action (keep_using|plan_migration|switch_now|verify_with_provider), replacement, shutdown_date, evidence, and freshness; pages are re-read every few hours. An unlisted id is verdict unknown, not an error; longer than 120 characters returns 400 bad_model_id. Example: {"model":"gpt-4-0613"}. Free within the daily quota, then $0.003 via x402. Alias: get_model (param id).

model.description: Exact API model id, not a display name or provider id. 1–120 characters; lowercased, and a leading models/ is stripped. Examples: gpt-4-0613, claude-3-opus-20240229, gemini-1.5-pro.

id.description: Deprecated alias of model, only for the get_model tool name. Same 1–120 character API id. Ignored when model is also set.

name: list_recent_api_changes
title: What changed recently in AI/dev APIs?
description: List the on-demand feed of recent AI and developer API changes (status flips, deprecation-page edits, model retirements, pricing-page edits). Use for a chosen window, one provider, or one kind, when explaining sudden breakage. Not for live up/down (check_api_status) and not for the once-a-day digest, which also covers MCP server breakage (get_digest). Returns summary, count, freshness, and changes[] with provider, kind, title, detail, source, and at, newest first. Status rows arrive within about 5 minutes; doc-page rows every few hours. A limit above 500 is clamped to 500; an unknown provider returns an empty list, not an error. Example: {"provider":"anthropic","kind":"model_retirement"}. Free within the daily quota, then $0.01 via x402. Alias: get_changes.

since.description: Exclusive lower bound compared to each change's at. ISO 8601 UTC. Example: 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Omit for 7 days ago.

provider.description: Optional lowercase provider id from list_providers, e.g. openai or anthropic. Omit for every provider.

kind.description: Optional type filter. status = provider state flips; deprecations = deprecation-page line edits; model_retirement = a model id became deprecated or retired; pricing = pricing-page line edits. Omit for all four.

limit.description: How many changes to return, newest first. Positive integer. Omit for 100.

name: list_providers
title: List tracked API providers
description: List every AI and developer API provider Upstream tracks (~40) with id, name, category, current state, checked_at, and status page. Use to pick a provider id for check_api_status, or for one all-providers health pass. Not for one provider's incidents (check_api_status) and not for what changed (list_recent_api_changes or get_digest). No parameters. Always free; does not spend the daily quota. State is refreshed about every 5 minutes. Returns {count, providers:[{id, name, category, state, checked_at, status_page}]}; state is operational, degraded, partial_outage, major_outage, maintenance, or unknown.

name: get_digest
title: Daily AI/dev API breaking-changes digest
description: Read one published daily breaking-changes digest: AI/dev API status flips, model deprecations and retirements, pricing-page edits, and breaking MCP server changes. Use for a once-a-day catch-up. For a filtered on-demand API feed with no MCP section, use list_recent_api_changes; for live up/down, check_api_status; for one model id, check_model_deprecation. Always free (no quota, no x402). Published once at 12:00 UTC as a frozen window since the previous issue (usually ~24h); not updated later. Omit date for the latest; a missing YYYY-MM-DD returns 404 {error:no_issue}. One issue per date, no paging. Returns {date, title, summary, window_start, window_end, published_at, markdown, data, url, sponsor:null}. data holds counts, status, open_now, model_changes, shutting_down_30d, pricing, deprecation_page_edits, and mcp (breaking, non_breaking, down, back, auth_broken, auth_fixed). markdown caps model rows, breaking MCP rows, and each MCP event kind at 30, 30, and 20; data is the full window.

date.description: Published issue date, YYYY-MM-DD (example 2026-10-14). Omit for the latest issue. A date with no stored issue returns 404 no_issue; issues appear at 12:00 UTC.
